newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U gets British ok for glaucoma drug.
newsitem.headline: P&U gets British ok for glaucoma drug.

text.p: Swedish-U.S. drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn said Friday its Xalatan glaucoma drug had won approval from British authorities.

"This approval is an important step for Pharmacia & Upjohn when it comes to the process of making Xalatan available all over Europe. We expect to have Xalatan approved in either EU countries in the middle of 1997," said Goran Ando, executive vice president.
The company said the drug has been approved for treatment of patients with the eye disorder who are intolerant to other medication.
